reason: False positive: «设定» here is the verb «set (by ImprovMX)», not the noun «settings» the glossary entry governs; «由 ImprovMX 设定» is correct (rubric rule 7).

«参加» is understandable and not an error; «参与» is a slightly better collocation for a framework — a stylistic improvement only, so recorded, not applied (rubric: correct wordings are not changed for taste).
The English is itself a fragment and «按照 GitHub 隐私声明中的规定» conveys it accurately; «以……为准» reads more finished but the change is stylistic, not an objective error (rubric rule 7).
